$comment: Changes to how the suite measures, drawn on Dyno's trend charts at the first run on or after `date` (only on the charts of `metrics`, when given). Notes about a machine or data go in the results directory's annotations.json (cli.mjs annotate), which never enters the repository.

annotations.text: JS heap is the main thread's and workers' live objects after a full GC, read over CDP; ArrayBuffer and WebAssembly memory are bufferBytes. Earlier runs' performance.memory reading is jsHeapReportedBytes (r39).
Runs serve the working tree frozen as a commit and built for production, not the live tree through Vite's dev server (which added 5.6 MB of JS heap and 19 MB of buffers on NYC; r39).
Baseline engines reuse stored repetitions after a calibration repetition (marked reused in each run), and a scene stops early once its comparison is decided (r39).

The suite page loaded this repository's unminified 1.x build on every run, 2.0's included: on NYC it added 23 MB to bufferBytes (its source text) and 5.6 MB to heapBytes on 2.0's main thread. 2.0 pages, at this tree or a ref, now load none (r39).
CesiumJS 1.147.0 joins the default engines and becomes the baseline (1.146.0 still runs).
